summary: Small gravel car park beside community garden and park, no homes near.
reasons: Backs onto garden, park and oval

best_section.where: Gravel car park at the community garden, east of the park path

drivers.seclusion: Garden plots, park and sports ground around it; only sheds nearby, no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Formed gravel road reaches it; marked bays with room for a van; mapped gates are not on the only way in.
drivers.traffic: Off the road network, only garden and park users.
drivers.convention: Open public car park (access yes, no fee) with a few cars in it.

flags: Low-lying: about 2.3 m elevation, Toowong Creek 48 m away
Mapped gates 14 to 30 m off; none seen closed in imagery
sun_shade: Open to the sky; trees along the east edge shade the morning sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the garden locks the access road
